title: Scan your niche nightly for posts that got traction
summary: A creator has a Grok-based research bot scan X every night for AI coding agent posts and pull out what earned reach, replies and bookmarks, with copyable templates.
agent_role: The bot scans the niche on X each night and identifies posts that performed well and why; the author packages the patterns into templates.
outcome: Author shares a write-up of performing post patterns with templates drawn from the bot's scans.
what_they_did: The poster runs a research bot built on Grok that scans posts about AI coding agents on X every night. It looks at what got reach, replies and bookmarks. The poster turned the patterns into post templates and shared them in an article.
how_it_went: The author says the result is a set of patterns, each with a template readers can copy for their own posts.
prompt: Every night, search X for posts from the last 24 hours about [your niche]. Pick the 20 with the most replies, reposts and bookmarks relative to the author's follower count. For each, note the hook, format, length and topic. Then write a short report: the 3–5 patterns that keep showing up, why you think they work, and a fill-in-the-blank template for each. Save the report to [a document or folder] and keep a running list of patterns across nights. Do not post anything yourself.

curation.rationale: A genuine recurring research agent that scans posts nightly and extracts patterns, but the post is thin and the findings sit in a linked article not provided.
